name: PDF.net
description:
Connect pdf.net to edit, generate, and organize PDFs in Claude. Your pdf.net library connects directly — no re-uploading every time.

Edit PDFs in place: change text, fix dates, fill forms. Generate new PDFs from a prompt — invoices, contracts, proposals. Merge up to 20 PDFs, split by page range, compress, and convert to Word, Excel, or PowerPoint. Translate full documents while keeping the layout. Organize your library into folders.

---

Working with PDFs can be slow. You convert to Word to edit, switch tools to merge, pay extra to translate, and dig through folders to find the file. pdf.net puts all of it in one chat.

Edit PDFs in place — no Word roundtrip. Generate invoices, contracts, and proposals from a prompt. Merge up to 20 files, split by page, compress, and convert to Word, Excel, or PowerPoint. Translate full documents while keeping the layout. Your pdf.net library stays connected, so files are one message away.

_published_faq.name: How do I add PDF.net to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add PDF.net to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.pdf.net/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the PDF.net MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: PDF.net lists 20 MCP tools, including apply_editor_command, compress_pdf_document, convert_pdf_document, copy_pdf_document, create_folder, delete_resource, describe_editor_pages, download_pdf_document, find_in_documents, generate_pdf_document, get_profile, and import_file_from_url.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to PDF.net?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to PDF.net in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
PDF.net requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
PDF.net is developed by PDF.net. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
